item.title: The Staff+ Operating Model: a practical field guide to technical leadership
item.description: A field guide for Senior SWE → Tech Lead → Staff/Principal: leadership without authority, the four archetypes, the three work pillars, the promotion arithmetic, and the traps that quietly stall careers. Now with the operating depth: real time-allocation numbers, the horizon of focus, incident-command mechanics, the room, decision reversibility, and the PM partnership.
